note:
The three content-block images on /pages/matrixyl-3000-research — templates/page.research-matrixyl.json, section `key_findings`, blocks f1, f2, f3. Malcolm, 2026-08-25: apply the learnings and style from the copper-peptide round 3 set.

MECHANISM FIRST, STYLE SECOND — the r3 lesson, and the reason r1 and r2 of the copper-peptide set drifted. Each block here makes a DIFFERENT KIND of claim and the three pictures must not be interchangeable:
  f1  Robinson 2005 — double-blind, placebo-controlled, SPLIT-FACE RCT, 93 women 35-55, 12 weeks. Statistically significant improvement in the appearance of fine lines and wrinkles versus the control side, by instrument AND expert grading. This is a MEASURED result, unlike the copper-peptide f3 which was self-reported satisfaction — so depicting a softened line is defensible here where it was not there.
  f2  Sederma manufacturer in-vitro data: +117% Collagen I, +327% Collagen IV, plus increased glycosaminoglycans and fibronectin, in CULTURED SKIN CELLS. So: an isolated laboratory specimen, cells actively making new fibre. Not a body.
  f3  Katayama 1993: the peptide SIGNALS skin cells to produce collagen and fibronectin, dose-dependent, in cell culture. This is the signalling event itself — the most mechanistic of the three, and the one that carries Matrixyl's actual story.

MATRIXYL'S STORY IS SIGNALLING, NOT DELIVERY, and that is what separates this set from the copper-peptide one. GHK-Cu carries a metal into tissue; Matrixyl 3000 is a pair of matrikine peptides that TELL fibroblasts to build. So f3 is built around docking and a signal travelling into the cell, and all three show new fibre being EXTRUDED BY CELLS rather than simply lighting up.

NO SPLIT-FACE FRAME, despite the study being split-face. A split frame is a comparison device that asserts a result by juxtaposition, and these engines render it as a hard seam down the middle. f1 instead uses the r3 response-gradient: one continuous surface furrow that is shallower where the dermal network beneath it has been reinforced and deeper further along, with a smooth falloff. Same information, one continuous scene, no comparison frame.

THE ACTIVE IS A PEPTIDE CHAIN, NOT COPPER BEADS — a deliberate, meaningful difference from the copper-peptide set. Matrixyl 3000 has no metal in it; it is two palmitoyl peptides, a TRIPEPTIDE and a TETRAPEPTIDE. So each delivery sphere holds a short chain of linked beads rather than a loose cluster, and the chains come in two lengths, three beads and four, which is quietly accurate to the duo. It also puts the brand's signature device — the peptide chain — inside the ingredient that most deserves it. Copper and gold are negated by name so the two ingredient sets never blur.

COLOUR: Matrixyl's scene colour is Teal 016569, per the concern-to-colour map, exactly as Clinical blue is Copper Peptide's. Tissue stays the desaturated peach-cream established in r3 — anatomy, not a brand colour — and the fibre network and delivery spheres carry the teal. Royal blue and cobalt are negated so this never drifts into the copper-peptide page's Clinical blue.

STYLE INHERITED FROM r3, UNCHANGED: layered cross-section with three legible strata; actives as translucent spheres above the surface; explicit downward delivery as shafts of light, NOT arrows; starburst glints at the point of arrival; soft high-key hazy ground; glossy luminous CGI. The r2 trap stays fixed — starburst sparkle is WANTED here and is not negated; only lightning, arc, laser and neon are barred.

All three blocks currently wear borrowed photographs: f1 a product shot of the Matrixyl serum, f2 and f3 the philosophy-page pictures. Square 2048x2048 to match the copper-peptide blocks. CLASS B, no references attached, FLUX.2 in the run.

slots.title: f1 · a surface line, softened where the network beneath has been reinforced
slots.prompt:
Soft three-dimensional medical explainer illustration in the style of premium skincare advertising: smooth glossy CGI, luminous and dreamy, high-key on a pale hazy gradient background. Square format.

A block of skin is shown in cross-section, seen from a low three-quarter angle so both its top surface and its cut face are visible, occupying the lower two thirds of the frame. Three strata are legible from top to bottom: a thin outer layer with a fine irregular texture of soft interlocking plates; beneath it a stack of two or three rows of flattened rounded translucent cells; and below that an open deeper zone filled with long wavy bundles of glossy fibre running horizontally. The tissue is a soft desaturated peach-cream, warm and pale. The fibre bundles are a deep blue-green teal, colour hex 016569, glassy and translucent against the warm tissue.

ACROSS THE TOP SURFACE RUNS ONE SINGLE SHALLOW FURROW, a soft-edged groove travelling from the near side of the block into the distance. It is not the same depth along its length: at the near end it is a deep, sharply folded crease, and as it travels away it becomes progressively shallower and softer until it is barely a dip, the change smooth and continuous.

Above the block float three translucent spheres of pale teal glass, each holding a short chain of small pearl-white beads linked in a row — two of the chains have three beads, one has four. From the underside of each sphere a slender shaft of warm white light descends, piercing the outer layer and reaching down into the deep fibre zone directly beneath the shallow end of the furrow.

WHERE THE SHAFTS ARRIVE, bright star-shaped glints burst among the fibres and the bundles there are markedly denser, thicker and more numerous, packed tightly and lifting upward so they visibly support and fill the tissue above them — which is exactly where the furrow above is shallowest. Beneath the deep end of the furrow, far from any shaft, the bundles are sparse, thin and slack, and the tissue above sags into the crease. Small bright sparkles drift in the reinforced zone.

Soft diffuse light, no hard shadow, shallow depth of field, the far edge dissolving into pale haze. Glossy, luminous, immaculate.

slots.title: f2 · laboratory specimen, cells producing new fibre
slots.prompt:
Soft three-dimensional medical explainer illustration in the style of premium skincare advertising: smooth glossy CGI, luminous and dreamy, high-key on a pale hazy gradient background. Square format.

A small block of laboratory-grown tissue is shown in cross-section from a low three-quarter angle, isolated in clean empty space with nothing around it, resting on a smooth translucent base so it reads unmistakably as a specimen rather than part of a body. Its interior is an open matrix of long wavy glossy fibre bundles in a deep blue-green teal, colour hex 016569, running horizontally through a soft desaturated peach-cream ground. Along the very bottom of the block the fibres gather into one fine, tightly woven flat mat, a distinct dense sheet different from the loose bundles above it.

Suspended among the bundles are five or six elongated spindle-shaped cells with long tapering arms that reach out and grip the surrounding fibres, each with a soft luminous centre, pale pearl-cream against the teal.

Above the specimen float three translucent spheres of pale teal glass, each holding a short chain of small pearl-white beads linked in a row — some chains of three beads, some of four. From each, a slender shaft of warm white light descends into the block and reaches the spindle cells.

THE CELLS ARE BUILDING. Where a shaft meets a cell a bright star-shaped glint bursts, and from the tips of that cell's arms fine new teal fibres are visibly streaming outward and weaving themselves into the surrounding matrix, thin and bright and clearly newer than the older bundles around them. Around the lit cells the matrix is dense, thick and richly woven; toward the far corners of the block, away from any cell that has been reached, it is noticeably sparse and thin, with wide empty gaps. The flat mat along the bottom is thickest and brightest directly beneath the lit cells. Small bright sparkles drift in the active zones.

Soft diffuse light, no hard shadow, shallow depth of field. Glossy, luminous, immaculate.

slots.title: f3 · the signal — the peptide docks and the cell responds
slots.prompt:
Soft three-dimensional medical explainer illustration in the style of premium skincare advertising: smooth glossy CGI, luminous and dreamy, high-key on a pale hazy gradient background. Square format.

A close view of ONE single elongated spindle-shaped cell lying diagonally across the middle of the frame, large and dominant, its long tapering arms reaching out to left and right, its surface smooth and glossy and pale pearl-cream, with a soft luminous rounded centre glowing inside it. Behind and around it, thrown far out of focus, lies a soft matrix of wavy teal fibre and pale haze.

ALONG THE UPPER MEMBRANE OF THE CELL sit several small cup-shaped forms, evenly spaced, like shallow sockets moulded into its surface. Descending toward them from above are short chains of small pearl-white beads linked in a row — some chains of three beads, some of four — each drifting down out of a translucent sphere of pale teal glass that hovers above and has opened. Two of the chains have already settled into the sockets and fit them exactly; a third is just meeting its socket.

AT EACH SEATED CHAIN A BRIGHT STAR-SHAPED GLINT BURSTS, and from that point a soft warm pulse of light travels inward across the membrane and down into the body of the cell, converging on its luminous centre, which is brighter than anything else in the frame.

FROM THE FAR SIDE OF THE CELL, out of the tips of both arms, fine new fibres in deep blue-green teal, colour hex 016569, are streaming outward and away, thin, bright and glassy, curving off into the blurred matrix beyond — visibly newly made and issuing from the cell itself. The cell is plump, taut and fully lit.

Small bright sparkles drift around the docking sites. Soft diffuse light, no hard shadow, very shallow depth of field with the background dissolving into pale haze. Glossy, luminous, immaculate.
